blocks.text: They have done it before, but Alexie Brooks and Anne Patricia Lorenzo Diaz are both suiting up for the Philippines anew in the international arena. The two of them faced the media ahead of their departure for another global pageant quest. Reina Filipinas threw a rousing send-off for the two titleholders at the Jojo Bragais Studio in Quezon City on Monday afternoon, Nov. 23, coinciding with a sale of pageant heels and other products to help raise funds for the two queens’ campaigns. MGI All Stars, a competition among former international pageant participants, and is also open to mothers, married women […]...
